facts.fact: The State Security Minister's gazette notice of 4 December 2015 publishes the National Cybersecurity Policy Framework as approved by Cabinet in March 2012, under which a JCPS Cybersecurity Response Committee, a Cybersecurity Hub and sector CSIRTs are to be set up.

systems.owner: Department of Telecommunications and Postal Services
systems.tiers: to be established under the framework; a CSIRT pooling public and private threat information

systems.country_label: RSA Government Electronic Communications Security Computer Security Incident Response Team (ECS-CSIRT)

systems.tiers: to be established; policy and coordination body

note: The framework designates no critical information infrastructure; it calls for a national strategy and regulations to identify it.
